content.comment_body: Hello, I plan to set up a [product_name] on each floor of my house. Is it possible to connect them using an AS module? If so, how many can be networked together, and does one need to act as Master, possibly requiring a special module? Is there any detailed documentation about the AS modules? Thanks in advance.

Hello [user_name], Regarding the AS module, I assume you're referring to an ASI extension module. In this scenario, a [product_name] can only operate as a slave on the ASI network, so you would need an ASI master. This could be a controller from the [product_name] series with a compatible CP-module. Best regards, [user_name]

Hi [user_name], thanks for the quick response. So, without an [product_name] CP-module, the [product_name] devices cannot communicate directly with each other? That's unfortunate. Many thanks and best regards.
Hello [user_name], That's correct. You can use input from one [product_name] device and connect it to the output of another to enable communication between them. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], You can achieve this with specific models from the Moeller Easy series.

analysis.insight_summary: Users aim to network multiple [product_name] devices on different floors. The main insight is that direct communication between these devices is limited; they function only as ASI slaves and require a master controller such as those from the [product_name] line with special communication modules. There's a clear interest in simpler, integrated networking without needing extra higher-level equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily network several [product_name] devices so that they can communicate either directly or through an intuitive master module. Access to comprehensive and clear documentation is also anticipated.
